name: science-statistics
description: Bounded, replayable descriptive statistics for scientific tables. Summarize a CSV by group, compute a two-group mean difference with its Welch standard error and degrees of freedom, apply a Benjamini-Hochberg false discovery rate adjustment to p-values you supply, and replay any result from its analysis record. Every result carries a record with the exact input, parameters, output and canonical SHA-256 hashes. Units, the experimental-unit column and a missing-value policy are required; repeated experimental units are flagged. It computes no p-values, confidence intervals or causal claims, records are tool-reported (consistency, not authentication), and nothing here is validated for clinical use. Offline, standard library only.
author: Buildersoft LLC

tools.name: scistat.describe
tools.description: Summarize a numeric column of a CSV table by group: n, missing count, mean, sample standard deviation, median, min and max. Requires the units, the experimental-unit column and a missing-value policy. Flags experimental units that repeat across rows. Limits: 1 MiB of CSV, 5,000 data rows, 64 columns. Returns the result and a replayable analysis record.

csv.description: CSV text with a header row (at most 1 MiB)

value_column.description: Header of the numeric column to summarize

group_column.description: Header of the column that names each row's group

unit_column.description: Header of the column that identifies the experimental unit (animal, patient, culture, plate)

units.description: Measurement units of the value column, for example mg/L

missing_policy.description: Applies to the value, group and experimental-unit cells (other columns are not read). exclude_and_report counts empty and NA values and leaves them out, and drops rows with a missing group or unit (counted in excluded_rows); reject fails on any such missing cell

tools.name: scistat.mean_difference
tools.description: Difference of two group means, mean(group_b) - mean(group_a), with the Welch standard error and Welch-Satterthwaite degrees of freedom. Each group needs at least 2 values. No p-value or confidence interval is computed. Same table arguments and limits as scistat.describe. Returns the result and a replayable analysis record.

csv.description: CSV text with a header row (at most 1 MiB)

units.description: Measurement units of the value column

tools.name: scistat.bh_adjust
tools.description: Benjamini-Hochberg false discovery rate adjustment of p-values you supply (at most 5,000, each between 0 and 1). Returns adjusted values in input order and whether each is at or below alpha. It does not compute the p-values themselves. Returns the result and a replayable analysis record.

labels.description: Optional label per p-value, same length

alpha.description: False discovery rate threshold, exclusive of 0 and 1 (default 0.05)

tools.name: scistat.replay
tools.description: Recompute a result from an analysis record produced by this skill and compare hashes. Returns REPLAY_MATCH or REPLAY_MISMATCH with the fields that differ. This checks consistency with the registered method only; it does not authenticate the record or validate the method choice.

record.description: An analysis record (schema sophon.science.analysis/1) as returned by scistat.describe, scistat.mean_difference or scistat.bh_adjust
